# awscc_apiportal_managed_api (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::APIPortal::ManagedApi. Promotes an API discovered in the API inventory into the managed API list.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_signature` (Attributes) Identifies a discovered API by its source resource, method, hostname, port, and path. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_signature))

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the managed API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the managed API was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `managed_api_arn` (String) The ARN of the managed API.
- `managed_api_id` (String) The managed API identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the managed API was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--api_signature"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_signature`

Required:

- `hostname` (String) The front-door hostname of the API.
- `method` (String) The HTTP method of the API.
- `path` (String) The route path of the API.
- `port` (Number) The port the API is served on.
- `resource_arn` (String) ARN of the source-service resource (API Gateway stage, load balancer, or CloudFront distribution).


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_managed_api.example
  identity = {
    managed_api_arn = "managed_api_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `managed_api_arn` (String) The ARN of the managed API

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_managed_api.example
  id = "managed_api_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_apiportal_managed_api.example "managed_api_arn"
```
